# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I am the Mute. I hold the defusal manual, which states:
- Blue light: cut blue wire
- Red light: cut red wire
- Yellow light: cut yellow wire

I cannot speak and cannot touch the bomb; I can only communicate via gestures to Deaf, who can see me. However, I have not yet heard from Deaf or Blind, so I do not know what light is lit or what wires exist on the bomb. Furthermore, without a common protocol established between Deaf and me, arbitrary gestures cannot convey precise instructions. Deaf speaks on their turn, which both Blind and I can hear. Deaf can inspect the bomb, describe the situation, and propose a gesture code for me to respond to.

Therefore, the correct action on Turn 1 is to wait for Deaf's report and instructions.

```
wait()
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I am Blind. I can cut wires at position 1, 2, or 3. Deaf goes next and should describe the bomb out loud. After Deaf speaks, check the manual and gesture the target wire number to Deaf (e.g. ☝ for 1, ✌ for 2, 🤟 for 3) so Deaf can tell me which wire to cut.
Deaf says: Bomb status: Display is 0. Light is yellow. Wires are 1: red, 2: yellow, 3: blue. Mute, check the manual and gesture to me what Blind should do: use ☝ for wire 1, ✌ for wire 2, 🤟 for wire 3, or gesture thumbs up/down.

The bomb's light is yellow. According to the defusal manual, when the light is yellow, the yellow wire must be cut. Deaf reported that wire 1 is red, wire 2 is yellow, and wire 3 is blue. Therefore, wire 2 is the correct wire to cut. Deaf requested gesture `✌` for wire 2. I will send the gesture `✌` to Deaf so Deaf can instruct Blind to cut wire 2.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have already signalled to Deaf that wire 2 is the correct wire to cut (matching the yellow light with the yellow wire at position 2). In Round 2, Deaf would have received my gesture and conveyed the instruction to Blind. Blind acts after Deaf's message arrives. To ensure there is no ambiguity or missed signal, I will reiterate the gesture for wire 2 to Deaf.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says: Wire 2 was successfully cut. New status: Display is 0. Light is blue. Wire 1: red, Wire 2: CUT, Wire 3: blue. Mute, check the manual and gesture to me: ☝ for wire 1, 🤟 for wire 3, or 👍 if complete.

The bomb's light is now blue. According to the manual, when the light is blue, the blue wire should be cut. Deaf reported that Wire 1 is red and Wire 3 is blue. Therefore, Wire 3 needs to be cut. Deaf requested gesture 🤟 for Wire 3. I will send 🤟 to Deaf.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I already signalled `🤟` for wire 3 in the previous turn. In the round order (Mute, Blind, Deaf), Deaf received my gesture at the end of Turn 4 and likely instructed Blind. Blind will execute the cut on Blind's turn in Turn 5. Repeating the gesture `🤟` ensures Deaf has the confirmation if needed.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says: Wire 3 was successfully cut. New status: Display is 0. Light is red. Wire 1: red, Wire 2: CUT, Wire 3: CUT. Mute, gesture to me: ☝ for wire 1, or 👍 if complete / other action.

The bomb's light is now red. According to the manual, when the light is red, the red wire should be cut. Deaf reported Wire 1 is red. Deaf asked for ☝ for wire 1. I will gesture ☝ to Deaf.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| red | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have signalled `☝` for Wire 1 on Turn 6. Deaf would have seen this and told Blind to cut Wire 1. I will repeat the gesture `☝` to Deaf to ensure consistency while Blind acts.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝"])
```
